paragraphs.text: Claude and Codex plan-usage meter for DeepSeek Harness
# dsh-usage-limits
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that shows how much of your Claude and Codex plan limits you have us

ed:
an omp-style line in the terminal client (`dst`, dsh-TUI) and a ring meter in dsh web. The produ

ct and
technical specification is SPEC.md; the test plan and evidence are in TESTING.md.
## What it shows
**dst.** One coloured line above the prompt, on the first screen (Launchpad) and in chat, in the for

mat of
Jake's omp line:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Each account shows its 5-hour and weekly windows: a bar, the percent used and the time to the reset.
Percents are green below 50%, amber from 50% and red from 80%. A narrow terminal drops the bars, th

en
the reset times, then shortens names (`Claude·px`), and finally shows only the fullest window. A

refresh
that fails keeps the last numbers and marks the account `stale`. Nothing shows until data ar

h
that fails keeps the last numbers and marks the account `stale`. Nothing shows until data arrives.

**dsh web.** A small ring and label beside the composer's context meter in a session, for example
`C
odex (proxy) 7d 52%`: the fullest 5-hour or weekly window, coloured by the same thresholds. Click it

for a
panel that lists every window of every account, including per-model windows such as `Weekly ·

Fable`
and extra Codex limits, with reset times and stale or error notes.
## Where the data comes from
Accounts, in display order:
| Account | Source |
| `Claude (proxy)`, `Codex (proxy)` | ProviderProxy: `GET <baseURL>/usage/claude` and `/usage/chatgp

t` with the proxy client key from `PROVIDERPROXY_API_KEY` (or `proxy.apiKeyEnv`) |
| `Claude`, `Code
x` | DSH's own sign-ins (`llm-pi-ai/anthropic`, `llm-pi-ai/openai-codex`) → `https://api.anthropic.c
om/api/oauth/usage`, `https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/usage` |
An account that is not configured is left out. The plugin never refreshes, writes or logs tokens; an
expired sign-in waits for DSH to refresh it. ProviderProxy accounts are read at most once a minute

(the
proxy caches its upstream for a minute); direct sign-ins at most every `minIntervalMs` (default

5 minutes,
never below 1 minute), with back-off after errors. `dst` asks every minute and redraws r

eset times every
30 seconds without a request; the web page polls the plugin's route every minute.
## Install
Both rows are generated by nix-config (`home/dsh.nix`); by hand they are:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`name` must point at the entry file (`index.js` or `tui.js`), not the package directory. DSH finds t

he
browser half through `package.json`. dsh-TUI 0.14.0 draws plugin status lines only in chat; the p

atch in
`patches/` (applied by nix-config's `pkgs/dsh-tui.nix`) puts them on the Launchpad too. dsh

web loads the
plugin when `dsh-web` starts; `dst` loads it in each new process.
